Italian

[edit]
Italian Wikipedia has an article on:
cuore
Wikipedia it

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈkwɔ.re/
  • Audio:(file)
  • Rhymes: -ɔre
  • Hyphenation: cuò‧re

Etymology 1

[edit]

From Vulgar Latin *corem m, from Latin cor n.

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • core (Tuscan[1] or literary/archaic, Romanesco), cor (apocopic)
  • quore (obsolete, now considered a misspelling)
  • cuor (apocopic)

Noun

[edit]

cuore m (plural cuori, pejorative cuoràccio/coràccio, diminutive-endearing cuoricìno/coricìno, derogatory cuoriciàttolo/coriciàttolo or (uncommon) cuorùccio/corùccio)

  1. heart
    1. (anatomy) muscular organ that pumps blood
    2. (uncountable) emotion, kindness, moral effort, or spirit
    3. (figurative) center, essence, or core
  2. breast, bosom
  3. (card games, in the plural) heart
